study.title: Altered Functional Activity and Functional Connectivity of Seed Regions Based on ALFF Following Acupuncture Treatment in Patients with Stroke Sequelae with Unilateral Limb Numbness
study.study_design: Prospective observational study with pre-post acupuncture intervention and healthy control comparison using resting-state fMRI
study.population: Stroke sequelae patients with unilateral limb numbness and age/gender-matched healthy controls
study.disease_condition: Ischemic stroke sequelae with unilateral limb numbness (somatosensory dysfunction)
study.inclusion_criteria: Patients: unilateral limb numbness following stroke; between 30 and 75 years old; right-handed; 6 months-5 years after the onset of stroke; lesion location indicated subcortical area confirmed by MRI; muscle strength of the affected limb is grade III or above; no mental disorders and no disturbance of consciousness; willing to accept acupuncture therapy for 4 weeks and sign informed consent. Healthy controls: right-handed; without central nervous system disease, psychosis and serious physical diseases; subjects had no history of psychiatric, neurological, or medical disease and no history of drug or alcohol dependence.
study.exclusion_criteria: Patients: lesion location indicated cortical areas confirmed by MRI; history of epilepsy or other neurological disease and psychiatric disorder; patients with pre-existent peripheral neuropathy including diabetic neuropathy; serious cognitive deficits; those who are unable to comprehend and participate in the examination, or those who have a MRI contraindication, such as claustrophobia.

arms.dropouts: 1 patient excluded due to incomplete data

interventions.anatomical_location_exact: GV20: median line of head; EX-HN1: located around GV20; GV26: upper part of philtrum; LI11: lateral side of elbow striae (affected side); ST36: lateral shinbone (affected side)
interventions.laterality_exact: LI11 and ST36 on affected side; GV20, EX-HN1, GV26 midline
interventions.depth_exact: GV20 and EX-HN1: 1.5 inches deep at 15-30 degrees above scalp surface; GV26: 5-10 mm towards the nose; LI11 and ST36: 20-30 mm obliquely downward toward the hand and foot
interventions.manipulation_exact: needle sheath was twirled and rotated to induce Deqi
interventions.deqi_intended_exact: Yes; Deqi (a sensation of soreness, numbness, distention, or radiating that is regarded to signify effective needling) was intended
interventions.number_of_sessions_exact: three times per week for 4 weeks
interventions.treatment_rationale_given_exact: According to Traditional Chinese Medicine theory, the acupuncture therapy is effective for treating post-stroke limb numbness.

sensory_interoceptive_responses.item_or_subscale_exact: Deqi sensation (soreness, numbness, distention, or radiating)
sensory_interoceptive_responses.value_exact: Deqi was induced throughout treatment by twirling and rotating needle sheath; described as soreness, numbness, distention, or radiating
sensory_interoceptive_responses.notes: Deqi was emphasized throughout treatment but no formal quantitative Deqi assessment scale was reported

neuroimaging_methods.scanner_manufacturer_model_exact: 3.0 Tesla Siemens Magnetom Verio MRI System (Siemens Medical, Erlangen, Germany)
neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: gradient echo-planar imaging (EPI) sequence with interleaved acquisition; high resolution T1-weighted volumetric three-dimensional spoiled gradient recall sequence
neuroimaging_methods.voxel_size_exact: FOV = 240 mm×240 mm, matrix = 128×128, slice thickness = 5 mm, slices = 31 (functional); FOV = 240 mm × 240 mm, matrix: 256 × 256, slice thickness = 1 mm, slices = 176 (T1)
neuroimaging_methods.preprocessing_software_exact: Statistical Parametric Mapping software (SPM12, http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm) and NITRC Functional Connectivity (CONN, http://www.conn-toolbox.org)
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: 4-mm full width at half maximum (FWHM) Gaussian kernel
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: data of maximum head motion > 1.5 mm and rotation angle > 1.5° in each direction (x, y, z) were excluded from further analysis
neuroimaging_methods.filtering_exact: linear drift and filtering were carried out to remove low frequency drift and high frequency breath and heartbeat noise; low-frequency range 0.01-0.08 Hz for ALFF

extraction_notes.note: No sham acupuncture or placebo control group was included in the study. Authors explicitly acknowledge this as a limitation: 'because there were no sham controls, it is difficult to determine how much of the improvement in numbness and fMRI performance was attributable to the placebo effect.'

No formal quantitative deqi assessment scale (e.g., MASS, MGQ, SASS) was used. Deqi was described qualitatively as 'soreness, numbness, distention, or radiating' and confirmed by the practitioner through needle twirling/rotation, but no quantitative data were reported.
Expectancy, credibility, blinding success, and allocation guessing were not assessed or reported in this study.
Adverse events were not reported. No statement about safety monitoring or adverse event occurrence appears in the paper.
Trial registration number is not reported in the paper.
The practitioner's qualifications, training, or years of experience are not described.

The paper states 24 patients were enrolled and 1 was excluded due to incomplete data, yielding n=23 for analysis. However, the paper does not specify whether the exclusion was pre- or post-imaging/treatment.

The seed regions for FC analysis used all 9 brain areas with decreased ALFF at baseline (L_SFG, R_TFC, R_MFG, L_MTG, R_PUT, R_preCG, R_PP, L_SMA, R_MTG), but the paper only reports significant FC results for some seeds (L_SFG, R_PUT, R_MTG for baseline comparison; R_MTG, R_MFG for post-acupuncture comparison). Results for remaining seeds (R_TFC, L_MTG, R_preCG, R_PP, L_SMA) were presumably non-significant but are not explicitly stated as null.

The lesion overlay map (Figure 2) shows patients with left-hemispheric lesions were flipped along the midsagittal plane so all lesions appear on the right hemisphere. The analysis may therefore treat all patients as if affected side is ipsilateral to the right hemisphere, but this is not explicitly clarified in the methods.

The table header for decreased FC (Table 4) uses seed region L_SFG to encompass four target areas (R_preCG, R_postCG, L_ITG, R_POC). It is stated that the seed region column shows 'L_SFG' for all four rows, consistent with one seed producing four significant target regions. Similarly, R_PUT targets R_preCG and R_MTG targets R_LOC. This is preserved in extraction.

The global signal regression procedure is not explicitly stated. Nuisance regressors mentioned are: six head motion parameters, white matter signal, and CSF signal linear. Global signal regression status is unclear.

The paper reports n=37 for two-sample t-test comparisons (23 patients + 14 healthy controls), and n=23 for within-patient paired comparisons. These values are inferred from reported group sizes and confirmed by the text, not directly stated as analysis n in the neuroimaging results tables.

Figure 3B shows whole-brain decreased ALFF map as a 3D surface rendering, and Figure 3A shows axial slices, but specific coordinate information for individual regions in Figure 3 is derived from Table 2, not directly readable from the figure. Figures 5A and 5B show FC maps post-acupuncture; coordinates are derived from Table 5.
The paper reports FA=90° for functional EPI and FA=15° for T1. The flip angle for functional acquisition is noted as standard; no concerns, but listed for completeness.

The study does not report how many of the 12 sessions patients actually attended (attendance/compliance data). The 4-week, 3x/week schedule implies 12 sessions, but individual adherence is not documented.
